worldcombat.skill.aquastep.summary: Dance around the target: a few light beats, then a final spin that sweeps a ring — the chosen foe takes it fully while others in the ring take a share and are shoved; landing the chosen foe boosts the user's Speed.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.0: Tap a few beats around the target, then spin
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.1: Sweep everyone standing in the ring
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.2: Boost Speed, then either back off or press in
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.description.0: The spin deals about %1$s damage; the user first taps %2$s beats around the target, %3$s blocks per beat at %4$s s per beat, and rain adds a beat and weight to the spin.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.description.1: The spin sweeps a %1$s block radius: the chosen target takes the full hit while other foes in the ring take %2$s of the damage; landing on the chosen target raises the user's Speed by %3$s stages (with an empty point, the first foe swept counts as the chosen one), and each swept target is pushed about %4$s blocks outward.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.twirl.on: Twirl: the beats circle the target and the final step lands behind it, for a trickier angle.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.twirl.off: Tap: the beats hop left and right out front, and the final step stays in front.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.preference.tw: On: the beats circle the target and the final step lands behind it. Off: hop left and right out front and finish in front.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.preference.ai: Only start dancing when the foe is within this range; smaller stays glued, larger closes in from farther.
Back off to this distance after the spin before deciding again; larger is less attached, smaller keeps pressing.
